title: Astra in rigging images to make gacha home screen animations
author: RuinousFate
selftext: While everyone was having success with Blender and Astra.... it wasn't quite the most useful for me and created Minecraft like 3D models for anime characters instead... what did end up useful was converting images to L2D-like animations. In this showcase video, my character, Santa Celeste, gets "clicked" (mouse not shown in video though) and triggers an animation reminiscent of what I'd see in an anime mobile game home screen. It's a step above the usual 2D sprite sheets I've been using and even has excellent (in my opinion!) jiggle physics! Not that I'd know shit as long as it looks nice.
